typography.rules: Avoid Inter/Space Grotesk. Headings must use Cormorant Garamond (Serif) to reflect spiritual heritage, body uses Outfit (Sans) for modern legibility. Use tight letter spacing for headings.

colors.rules: Light UI only. No harsh blacks (use #1A1614). Use warm saffron (#EA6A16) for primary CTAs and highlights. Use river blue (#29ABE2) sparingly for subtle aquatic accents.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Light glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/70 border border-white/60 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(26,22,20,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.cards: Soft rounded corners (rounded-3xl), subtle ambient shadows shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(234,106,22,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.images: Clipped photo frames (arched tops, pill shapes, or rounded-3xl). Use a subtle radial-gradient spotlight behind key hero images to create depth.

component_strategy.marketing_sections: Custom HTML/Tailwind for asymmetrical Bento grids, overlapping elements, generous spacing. Avoid generic Bootstrap-style columns.
component_strategy.interactive_components: Shadcn UI (Buttons, Accordions, Forms, Dialogs, Cards) heavily customized to strip the Vercel look. Apply rounded-full to buttons and rounded-3xl to cards.
component_strategy.marquees: react-fast-marquee for slow editorial ribbon with Cormorant Garamond text, separated by small dots or diyas.

grids.marketing: Asymmetrical 'Bento' or 'Tetris' grid. Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Never fill 100% perfectly. Leave negative space for breathing room.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32 to give the layout an airy, premium feel.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-first. Left-aligned text for better readability, centered only for deliberate artistic impact in hero or blockquotes.

motion.hero: Signature on-load masked line-by-line text reveal using framer-motion (y: 100%, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1 inside a overflow-hidden container).
motion.scroll: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Framer-motion for scroll-reveals (fade-up, slight translate-y).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards (slight lift -translate-y-1, shadow increase), button hover (subtle scale 1.02 or color shift).

3d_libraries.usage: Create a subtle parallax hero moment by layering text and image elements moving at different Y speeds on scroll using Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform. No heavy WebGL needed to maintain elegant cleanliness.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast using gradient overlays (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#1A1614]/70 to-transparent).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

Sunset ceremony over the river with a large crowd

community.description: Volunteers collecting trash along a riverbank

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium, award-worthy React application. Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Implement numbered manifesto chapters for the Vision/Mission/History section.
Create a slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee showing spiritual/brand keywords.
Design a Historical Timeline component using Framer Motion scroll reveals.
Build dummy payment forms for Aarti/Pooja booking and Donations. Use customized Shadcn UI components.
Create a sticky navigation bar with glassmorphism and a floating 'Donate' button.
The Trust members section must display the exact 6 member images provided in the media object. For 'Paresh Mistry' (who has no image), use an Avatar component with initials 'PM'.
Use Apple-level cleanliness: abundant whitespace, large elegant typography, minimal harsh borders.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use asymmetrical layouts and overlapping elements.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
Do not apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Target specific properties to prevent breaking framer-motion transforms.
Do not center align the App container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
